headings: H2: Messages and Parts in Corti

clean_room_contracts_extracted.authoritative_source_per_corti: A2A Core Concepts and Components documentation at a2a-protocol.org (Corti adds Corti-specific detail on top)

core_actors.name: User
core_actors.role: clinician / contact-center agent / knowledge worker / automated service; initiates request

core_actors.name: A2A Client (Client Agent)
core_actors.role: the application calling Corti; initiates A2A communication; orchestrates results

core_actors.name: A2A Server (Remote Agent)
core_actors.role: Corti agent or agentic system exposing HTTP endpoint implementing A2A Protocol; receives requests, processes tasks, returns results/updates

uses_in_corti: register and describe your own remote agents
declare authentication and compliance requirements before PHI/sensitive data exchange

message_contract.design_rationale: modality independent; lets Corti mix clinical text, transcripts, and structured data in single exchange

part_kinds_3.content: plain textual content (instructions, questions, generated notes)
structured JSON data (clinical facts, workflow params, EHR IDs, machine-readable info)
file (PDF discharge letter, audio recording); inline Base64 OR URI; has name + mimeType

artifact_contract.lifecycle: tied to task lifecycle; can be streamed incrementally
examples_corti_lists: extracted clinical facts or coding suggestions

task_vs_message_response.task: long-running operation (full clinical document, multi-tool coordination, downstream system wait)
task_vs_message_response.implication: iCoDer A1B-AE.5 must support BOTH response modes; agent chooses based on expected duration

icoder_mapping.agent_card: ICODER_V1_AGENT_CARD_SPEC.md already exists; A1B-AE.4 must verify alignment with this Corti public contract
icoder_mapping.message_part: iCoDer Phase 6 Gate 3 unified envelope {name, payload, meta} supports TextPart + DataPart; FilePart is a clean-room addition
